description: This file contains end-to-end tests for compliance export commands in the Mattermost server, including listing, showing, canceling, and downloading compliance export jobs, as well as testing job start time logic related to mmctl jobs.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportListCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests for listing compliance export jobs, including no jobs, pagination, and multiple jobs.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportShowCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests for showing details of a compliance export job, including non-existent and existing jobs.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportCancelCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests for canceling compliance export jobs, including permission checks, non-existent jobs, and job state errors.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportDownloadCmdE2E
methods.description: Tests for downloading compliance export files, including permission checks, non-existent jobs, existing files, and zip content verification.

methods.name: TestComplianceExportMmctlJobStartTimeE2E
methods.description: Tests for verifying that mmctl jobs use the batch_start_time from previous regular jobs for job_start_time, and behavior with multiple mmctl jobs.
